Local document-reader dependencies: Tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0), tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0), pdfjs-dist 6.5.438 (Apache-2.0), Arabic/English traineddata from tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0_fast. All assets are self-hosted; document bytes remain in browser during extraction. PDF scan limit: first 5 pages. Proposed Gregorian dates require human confirmation. See adjacent licenses.
